reasons: Cited Section 18.1 matches the preferred position on all limits: CGL USD 1M/2M, workers' compensation as required by law, E&O USD 2M, and cyber/privacy USD 5M, maintained at Vendor's expense through the term plus one year.
Section 18.2 supplies certificates of insurance on request and confirms insurance does not limit Vendor's liabilities, so no insert or fallback is needed.
Consistent with a compliant finding, no redline or comment was proposed and the paragraphs are unchanged; deterministic check confirms an insurance obligation is present.
The 'to the extent available from its insurer' qualifier on cancellation notice is not part of the playbook position and does not undercut compliance at this low severity.
